title: Annual plan, renewal said in plain words

expect.summary: Renewal is paraphrased, not the stock phrase. The model step finds it and the quote is verified word for word. Passes. In rules-only mode this item comes back missing.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Dolores Reyes. I'd like the yearly option for myself.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Of course, Dolores. GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, that's what my friend told me.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Total Care on the annual option is $480.00 per year, billed once a year.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: When the year is up, your membership carries on into the next year by itself at the same price, and we bill the card again each year until you tell us to stop.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, that's clear, it keeps going each year till I stop it.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: You can cancel any time with no fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in your account settings.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our toll-free number is 1-855-464-6872 and our email is support@gogograndparent.com, for cancelling or any questions.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Dolores, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Visa ending in 6624 $480.00 today and again each year until you cancel?
